scientific_question.primary: Does replacing the historical duplicated node-indexed PLAN / ABORT selection identities with the semantic k + 2 representation produce stable severity-conditioned behaviour at the certified ego's immediate-fuel-damage wake?
scientific_question.secondary: Using the newly integrated per-transition credit diagnostics, does the immediate-FD transition receive different actor-only credit under MILD versus SEVERE?
scientific_question.evidence_class: DEVELOPMENT evidence only; not confirmatory evidence.
